item.source_text: P06 moves alert detection from a clerk to a mechanical latch, with a supplied trigger path. The latch requires daily inspection and twenty minutes of operator jam clearing per incident. The proposal claims the human function is wholly eliminated and assigns no remaining responsibility or maintenance cost.
item.question: Does this relocation meet P06?

answer.reason: A trigger path supports detection relocation, but the claim of wholly eliminating the human function omits required inspection and jam-clearing work. Remaining responsibility and maintenance cost are unassigned.

A supplied trigger path establishes relocation of alert detection to the latch. Daily inspection and incident jam clearing retain human work, while the proposal omits its responsibility and cost and overclaims elimination. The transfer is supported but the complete relocation account is not.
